name: Walking Classifier
description: ONNX walking classifier using a small 1D CNN over bilateral acceleration magnitude windows.

inputs.name: left_ankle
inputs.description: Left ankle 3-axis accelerometer at 100Hz over a 4 s window. The wrapper converts to dynamic acceleration magnitude.

inputs.name: right_ankle
inputs.description: Right ankle 3-axis accelerometer at 100Hz over a 3 s window. The wrapper converts to dynamic acceleration magnitude.

parameters.name: scale_to_g
parameters.label: Convert m/s² to g
parameters.description: Divide all accelerometer channels by 9.81 before preprocessing.
